title: @types/sanitize-filename is deprecated
summary: npm marks @types/sanitize-filename as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. sanitize-filename provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/sanitize-filename only declares types; sanitize-filename now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/sanitize-filename from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep sanitize-filename on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from sanitize-filename.

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with sanitize-filename's own declarations.
